named_framework: DIDS-MFL: disentangled dynamic intrusion detection with multi-scale representation fusion
methodological_commitments: Known, unknown/zero-shot style, and few-shot attack scenario evaluation
Statistical/representational disentanglement of entangled traffic features
Dynamic graph diffusion for spatiotemporal/topological aggregation
Multi-scale representation fusion for few-shot generalization
Compare against simpler NIDS baselines and validate consistency across attack types
planned_fallback: If exact DIDS-MFL architecture is infeasible from the single PT dataset, implement a faithful lightweight approximation: disentangled feature branches, kNN graph diffusion over flows, multi-scale fused embeddings, and prototype/linear heads, with deviations documented.
